note: Evidence levels: mock = scripted fakes; synthetic_logic = scripted skeletons/scores; real_model_smoke = a real model on a handful of public images (not an accuracy figure); dataset_measured = measured on a named public dataset (not the Pi camera); static_check = source-code scan; stub_only = ROS stubs; tool_only = evaluation harness exists, no data; hardware_required = cannot be measured without the robot. No area has a real-camera result.

areas.name: Camera acquisition
areas.measured: Logic with a mock source, a video-file source and a fake Picamera2 driver.
areas.not_verified: Real Pi Camera Module 2 capture, format, exposure and frame rate.
areas.manual_procedure: On the Pi: python -m buddy_core.vision.camera_node with backend picamera2; confirm /camera/image_raw with ros2 topic hz.

areas.name: Shared frame stream
areas.measured: Every consumer sees the same read-only frame; a slow consumer never blocks the camera.
areas.not_verified: Behaviour under real Pi CPU load with all stages running.
areas.manual_procedure: Run the vision node plus a second image subscriber on the Pi and compare frame rates.

areas.name: Camera disconnection
areas.measured: Scripted failures: reconnect with backoff, vision state cleared, voice hint cleared, one report, recovery.
areas.not_verified: Unplugging the real ribbon cable or USB camera; a fall check in progress when the camera dies is dropped, not escalated.
areas.manual_procedure: With the robot idle, disconnect the camera and watch /vision/events for camera_lost, then reconnect.

areas.name: Multiple people
areas.measured: Tracker identity, enrollment safety and per-person cooldowns with scripted detections.
areas.not_verified: Crowded scenes, occlusion by other people, identity swaps on a real camera.
areas.manual_procedure: Record a consented clip with two people crossing; run identity_eval and count swaps.

areas.name: Unknown person
areas.measured: Strangers stay unnamed, are never enrolled, never have expression read, nothing is written to disk.
areas.not_verified: Real false-accept rate of strangers against an enrolled gallery (no multi-person dataset in the sandbox).
areas.manual_procedure: Run identity_eval on a consented folder with enrolled and stranger images; read the false-accept row.

areas.name: Face recognition confidence
areas.measured: Real SFace on two public-domain people (one same-person pair, one different-person pair). That is a smoke test, not an accuracy figure.
areas.not_verified: Thresholds are uncalibrated; no FAR/FRR/EER measured on real data.
areas.manual_procedure: python -m buddy_core.vision.evaluation identity --help; run it on a consented, multi-person capture set from the Pi camera.

areas.name: Consent-based enrollment
areas.measured: Dialogue and storage rules with scripted faces.
areas.not_verified: Spoken consent through the real voice engine and microphone.
areas.manual_procedure: Say the enrollment phrases to the robot and confirm nothing is saved until the final yes.

areas.name: Recognition with and without glasses
areas.measured: None. The folder-based identity evaluation exists and flags small samples.
areas.not_verified: No glasses/no-glasses data exists in the sandbox, so nothing is measured or claimed.
areas.manual_procedure: Capture consented images of the same person with and without glasses; run identity_eval and compare per-condition rows.

areas.name: Lighting changes
areas.measured: Synthetic brightness/contrast changes and quality gates. Poor frames are excluded from recognition and expression.
areas.not_verified: Real room lighting, backlight, night, IR; accuracy per lighting condition.
areas.manual_procedure: Capture the same consented person in bright, dim and backlit rooms and run identity_eval per folder.

areas.name: Head-angle changes
areas.measured: Landmark-based head-turn flag and pose-variety requirement at enrollment.
areas.not_verified: Recognition and expression accuracy at real yaw/pitch angles.
areas.manual_procedure: Capture consented images at 0, 30, 60 degrees yaw and compare scores.

areas.name: Facial-expression smoothing
areas.measured: Temporal smoothing logic on scripted score sequences.
areas.not_verified: Behaviour on a real face video; the time constants were chosen, not tuned on data.
areas.manual_procedure: Record a consented clip of changing expressions and inspect the smoothed state timeline.

areas.name: Emotion prediction uncertainty
areas.measured: FER2013 test set (cross-dataset, NOT the Pi camera): zoo model 55.5% accuracy, macro-F1 0.445, ECE 0.32 (0.027 after temperature scaling). Confusion matrices and per-class precision/recall in docs/evaluation/test_matrix.md.
areas.not_verified: Not representative of the Pi camera, home lighting or this household. Skin tone, age, glasses and occlusion are not labelled in FER2013, so none of those slices were evaluated.
areas.manual_procedure: python -m buddy_core.vision.expression_eval --help; run on consented, labelled captures from the robot.

areas.name: Audio/visual disagreement
areas.measured: Fusion rules tested against the real voice EmotionFusion class.
areas.not_verified: Real voice features from a real microphone together with a real face.
areas.manual_procedure: Say 'I'm fine' with a neutral face and with a frown, with the robot running; confirm the stated words win.

areas.name: Repeated-event suppression
areas.measured: Greeting, expression, gesture and fall-alert repetition limits.
areas.not_verified: Long real-world sessions.
areas.manual_procedure: Leave the robot running with a person in view for 30 minutes and count events.

areas.name: Proactive interaction cooldown
areas.measured: Cooldown, daily limit and persistence across restarts.
areas.not_verified: Whether the chosen cooldowns feel right to real users.
areas.manual_procedure: A user study with consenting participants.

areas.name: User refusal
areas.measured: Refusal phrases, silence and 'stop asking' handling.
areas.not_verified: Speech recognition of refusals on real audio.
areas.manual_procedure: Say no / leave me alone / stop asking to the running robot.

areas.name: Object recognition
areas.measured: Real NanoDet on one sample image. No home-object dataset exists here. A false 'sheep' appeared on a microscope photo, so false positives are real.
areas.not_verified: Detection and taught-object precision/recall in a real home. Match thresholds are uncalibrated.
areas.manual_procedure: python -m buddy_core.vision.object_eval --help on a labelled folder (labels.json) of home objects.

areas.name: New object enrollment
areas.measured: Teach, confirm, duplicate and correction flows with a stand-in embedder.
areas.not_verified: Teaching with a real hand-held object and the real MobileNetV2 features on the Pi.
areas.manual_procedure: Teach three household objects, then ask 'what is this?' under changed lighting and report hits and misses.

areas.name: Object memory retrieval
areas.measured: Memory rules and honest 'last seen' wording. Off by default.
areas.not_verified: Accuracy of place recognition in a real home.
areas.manual_procedure: Enable object memory, move an object, and ask where it is.

areas.name: Fall detection
areas.measured: Logic on scripted skeletons only. No fall recording, real or staged, exists here.
areas.not_verified: Sensitivity to real falls, thresholds, pose-model accuracy on lying people. Not a medical or safety device.
areas.manual_procedure: Staged, supervised soft-mat falls with consent, recorded and replayed through pose + FallDetector.

areas.name: False fall detections
areas.measured: Scripted look-alike movements. The real false-alarm rate is unmeasured.
areas.not_verified: Pets, laundry, yoga, napping on a sofa, shadows, real pose errors.
areas.manual_procedure: Run 24 h of consented ordinary home video through the pipeline and count fall_suspected events.

areas.name: Gesture recognition
areas.measured: Whole-arm gestures on scripted skeletons. Hand-shape gestures are not implemented.
areas.not_verified: Real waving, pointing, clothing, distance, pose-model error.
areas.manual_procedure: Record consented volunteers doing each gesture and rest; report per-gesture precision/recall.

areas.name: Person-follow request cancellation
areas.measured: Cancellation logic against a mock navigation adapter.
areas.not_verified: The real navigation stack. Follow and approach are not wired to ROS.
areas.manual_procedure: After navigation is validated: wheels-off-ground test, then supervised tests with an emergency stop in hand.

areas.name: Unsafe approach refusal
areas.measured: With real-hardware capabilities (no distance sensor), every request is refused.
areas.not_verified: Safe approach itself. Buddy cannot be said to approach people safely until navigation and distance safety are validated.
areas.manual_procedure: Not applicable until navigation validation exists.

areas.name: Loss of target tracking
areas.measured: Lost-target timeouts and identity lock with scripted tracks.
areas.not_verified: Real occlusion and re-identification.
areas.manual_procedure: Walk behind furniture on camera and review the track log.

areas.name: ROS 2 topic compatibility
areas.measured: Stubs generated from the repo's .msg/.srv files with strict fields. rclpy was never available.
areas.not_verified: Everything under real ROS 2 (QoS, build, colcon, discovery). Topic names other than /emotion/observation are assumptions.
areas.manual_procedure: colcon build; ros2 run buddy_core vision_node; ros2 topic echo each topic; ros2 service call each service.

areas.name: Camera coexistence with voice integration
areas.measured: One camera owner enforced by node name and lock file; vision node has no dependency on voice or motion code.
areas.not_verified: Camera node vs Yohan's camera_node (same topic and node name) was never run together; voice and vision running together on the Pi.
areas.manual_procedure: Start voice_companion and vision_node together; say stop while a person is in view; check both stay responsive.

areas.name: Offline operation
areas.measured: Only the model download tool (models.py) imports a network library. Models are checked by SHA-256 from local files.
areas.not_verified: A full run with the network physically disconnected on the Pi.
areas.manual_procedure: Pull the network cable, start the vision node, and confirm all stages load from local files.

areas.name: Raspberry Pi CPU and memory limits
areas.measured: Sandbox x86 numbers exist and are labelled is_raspberry_pi=false. No Pi number exists.
areas.not_verified: All Pi CPU, memory, temperature and FPS figures.
areas.manual_procedure: python -m buddy_core.vision.benchmark --out benchmark_results/pi.json on the Pi; only a file with machine.is_raspberry_pi true counts.

areas.name: End-to-end conversational latency
areas.measured: The data flow works in order with fakes. No latency was measured.
areas.not_verified: Camera to spoken reply latency, which also depends on the voice engine and speaker.
areas.manual_procedure: Time from a person's reply to speech start on the Pi, over 20 trials, reporting median and worst case.
